entities.summary: William Chandler Bagley, was an American educator and editor. He graduated in 1895 from Michigan State Agricultural College, currently called Michigan State University; completed MS, in 1898, from the University of Wisconsin–Madison, 1898; and was awarded PhD by Cornell University in 1900. Bagley was one of the founders of Kappa Delta Pi, the National Professional Association and Honor Society for Educators, at the University of Illinois in 1911.
